title: Security Questionnaire Answering Assistant
summary: Draft answers to security and AI due-diligence questionnaires from your own policies, reports and past answers, with citations, confidence and owner approval before anything goes to a customer.

seo.title: Security Questionnaire Answering Assistant | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that drafts SIG, CAIQ and custom security questionnaire answers from your policies and past responses, with citations and security team approval.

designed_for: Head of Security or GRC Lead

problem.intro: Every enterprise deal brings a security questionnaire: a SIG Lite, a CAIQ, a custom spreadsheet of hundreds of rows, and now an AI-specific section. Security engineers answer the same questions again and again in slightly different words, and deals wait while they do.

pain_points.title: Repeated work across deals
pain_points.detail: Most questions have been answered before, but finding the last good answer and adapting it still takes time.

pain_points.title: Inconsistent answers
pain_points.detail: Different people answer the same question differently, creating contradictions that customers notice.

pain_points.title: Outdated evidence
pain_points.detail: Answers refer to old policies, expired reports or architecture that has since changed.

pain_points.title: New AI questions
pain_points.detail: Customers now ask about model providers, data retention, prompt injection testing and AI governance, and there is no approved answer yet.

solution.overview: We build an assistant that drafts questionnaire answers from your own approved sources. It reads incoming questionnaires as spreadsheets, documents or portal exports, splits them into questions, and searches an answer library built from your policies, security reports, architecture notes, trust centre content and past approved responses. Each draft answer cites the source passages it used, carries a confidence score, and flags questions with no supporting evidence instead of inventing an answer. The security owner reviews, edits and approves in one screen, and approved answers flow back into the library. The assistant also warns when a cited source is past its review date.
capabilities: Reads questionnaires in Excel, Word, PDF and common portal export formats
Retrieves from policies, reports, architecture notes and past approved answers
Drafts answers with citations to the source passage
Flags questions with no evidence rather than inventing answers
Review and approval screen for security owners
Stale-source warnings and an answer library that grows with each approval

workflow.title: Import the questionnaire
workflow.detail: The questionnaire file or portal export is imported and split into individual questions.

workflow.title: Retrieve evidence
workflow.detail: For each question, the assistant searches policies, reports and past approved answers.

workflow.title: Draft with citations
workflow.detail: It drafts an answer that cites its sources and scores its confidence.

workflow.title: Flag gaps
workflow.detail: Questions with weak or no evidence are flagged for an owner instead of being answered.

workflow.title: Owner review
workflow.detail: The security or GRC owner edits and approves answers, and assigns gaps.

workflow.title: Export and learn
workflow.detail: Approved answers are exported in the customer's format and saved to the answer library.

inputs: Incoming questionnaires in Excel, Word, PDF or portal export form
SOC 2 report, ISO/IEC 27001 statement of applicability and pentest summaries
outputs: Draft answers with citations and confidence
List of evidence gaps with owners
Completed questionnaire in the customer's format
Audit log of who approved each answer
human_in_the_loop: A security or GRC owner approves every answer before it leaves the company. The assistant never sends answers directly to a customer, and gap questions are always answered by a person.
integrations: Document storage such as Google Drive, SharePoint, Confluence or Notion
CRM such as Salesforce or HubSpot for deal context
Slack or Microsoft Teams for owner notifications
Customer portals via export and import
guardrails: Every answer must cite a source; uncited drafts are blocked
No claims of certifications or controls that are not in the sources
Confidential reports visible only to approved roles
Full audit trail of edits and approvals
compliance_notes: Keeps answers traceable to approved documents, which supports consistent representations to customers.
Source documents stay in your environment, and models are configured not to retain or train on them.

pilot.scope: An answer library built from your current policies and the last few completed questionnaires, then tested on two or three new questionnaires.
deliverables: Accuracy report against security owner edits

what_we_measure.how: Share of drafts approved with no or minor edits by the security owner.
Sampled answers checked for whether the cited passage supports the answer.
Owner time to complete a questionnaire with and without the assistant.
Questions flagged as lacking evidence, and how many led to new approved content.

faqs.q: Will it make up answers about our security?
faqs.a: It is built not to. Every answer must cite one of your approved sources, and questions without evidence are flagged for a person to answer. The security owner approves everything before it is sent.
Yes. Questions about model providers, data retention, testing and oversight are answered from your AI policies and test records. Where those do not exist yet, the gap list shows what needs writing.

faqs.q: Where are our confidential reports stored?
faqs.a: In your environment or a dedicated cloud tenant, with role-based access. Models are configured not to retain or train on your documents.

faqs.q: Does it work with customer portals?
faqs.a: Most portals allow questions to be exported and imported. The assistant works with those files, and approved answers are imported back.
